# Final agent prompts

The system prompt and tool declarations each agent receives with its first model request, captured from a real session on a scripted model. Text that varies by machine, user, session or configuration is shown as a `{{PLACEHOLDER}}`; everything else is the exact text the model reads. Regenerate with `yarn workspace @octocodeai/octocode-agent run generate:prompts` (a test fails when these files are stale). The unreplaced captures are written to `.octocode/agent/tmp/agent-prompts/`.

- [`main.md`](main.md): The session the user talks to: native tools, the Octocode MCP server, skills and project AGENTS.md.
- [`general.md`](general.md): A subagent started without a role.
- [`researcher.md`](researcher.md): A subagent started with the bundled `researcher` role.
- [`implementer.md`](implementer.md): A subagent started with the bundled `implementer` role.
- [`reviewer.md`](reviewer.md): A subagent started with the bundled `reviewer` role.
- [`browser.md`](browser.md): A subagent started with the bundled `browser` role.
- [`lean.md`](lean.md): A subagent started with the bundled `lean` role.

## Placeholders

| Placeholder | Stands for | Rendered by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{{MCP_SERVERS}}` | The `<mcps>` block: the instructions of every MCP server the user enabled, one `<mcp>` element each. | `packages/mcp/src/section.ts` (`renderMcpsSection`) |
| `{{MCP_TOOL_SUMMARIES}}` | The `- mcp__<server>__*: ...` lines of the `<tools>` list, one per enabled MCP server. | `packages/mcp/src/section.ts` and the tool snippets of `src/octocode/native/tools/` |
| `{{MCP_TOOLS}}` | The `mcp__<server>__<tool>` declarations (description and schema) of the enabled MCP servers. | `packages/mcp/src/tool-definition.ts`; the servers come from the user's MCP configuration |
| `{{CWD}}` | The absolute path of the working directory. | `src/core/system-prompt.ts` |
| `{{PROJECT_CONTEXT}}` | The `<project_context>` block: the AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md files of the working directory and its ancestors. | `src/octocode/native/prompts/system/project-context.md`, files loaded by `src/core/resource-loader.ts` |
| `{{SKILLS_LIST}}` | The `path: description` lines at the end of the `skill` tool's description: the skills this agent may load (bundled, user and project skills). | `src/octocode/native/tools/skill/description.md` and `src/core/skills/listing.ts` |
| `{{HARNESSES}}` | The `<harnesses>` block: which other agents' hooks, MCP servers and memory files are on or off. | `src/octocode/` harness switch (`/harness`) |
| `{{ENVIRONMENT}}` | The `<environment>` block: platform, shell and today's date. | `src/octocode/native/prompts/system/environment.md` |
| `{{HOST_PROBE}}` | The two `Host:` / `Host notes:` lines of the bash description: the probed OS, tools on PATH and platform notes. | `src/octocode/files/bash/cli-guide.ts` |
